Market today: Tech is getting hammered, especially chip names, driven by Nvidia's earnings miss. This is hitting your concentrated book hard.

Your holdings: SMCI (-43.7%), SOXL (-78.45%), and MU (leveraged) (-63%) are deep in the red and need immediate attention. Your other leveraged ETFs and QQQ are also down significantly. CRWD (+34.23%) is your only winner, but it's marked for TRIM.

Watch: Nvidia's earnings fallout and any follow-through in the semiconductor sector. Also, keep an eye on the broader market indices like SPY and QQQ.

Bottom line: Your leveraged tech bets are bleeding, and you need to seriously consider cutting losses on the worst offenders.
plays: Consider trimming SMCI, SOXL, and MU further. Their losses are substantial and leveraged positions amplify drawdowns.
Respect the stop on QQQ at 670. A break below could signal further downside.
No new buys today - hold and watch
